product.name: EKENÄSET chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 5 pieces
steps.instruction: Join 5 pieces (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the EKENÄSET chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 11 cm), B (piece, about 78 cm), C (piece, about 11 cm), D (piece, about 13 cm), E (piece, about 10 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
